title: Etale polynomial coordinates generating a smooth section kernel
statement: Let $g:V\to S$ be smooth of pure relative dimension $d$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] with a closed section $s:S\to V$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. For every $t\in S$, there are affine opens $T\subseteq S$, $U\subseteq V$ with $t\in T$, $U\subseteq g^{-1}T$, $s^{-1}U=T$, and an etale ring map $\psi:\Gamma(T)[X_1,\ldots,X_d]\to\Gamma(U)$ over the restricted map of $g$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], such that the extension of the variable ideal is the section kernel [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf].

lemma exists_etale_coordinates_of_mem_range (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 B) (b : B) :
    ∃ (W : B.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen W) (U : V.AffineZariskiSite) (hUW : U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W),
      b ∈ W ∧ s ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = W ∧ ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial (Fin d) Γ(B, W) →+* Γ(V, U.1), ψ.Etale ∧
        ψ.comp MvPolynomial.C = (g.appLE W U.1 hUW).hom ∧
        s.ker.siteIdeal U = (Ideal.mvPolynomialOrigin Γ(B, W) (Fin d)).map ψ
